name: Pole test
description: The animal is placed head-upward at the top of a vertical pole and must turn and descend to the base. Assesses bradykinesia and motor coordination, commonly in models of Parkinson's disease.

parameters.label: Pole length
parameters.help: Length of the pole from the top, where the subject is placed, to the base.

parameters.label: Turn descent
parameters.help: Net downward movement from the highest point on the pole that marks the completed turn.

parameters.label: Fall speed
parameters.help: Downward speed above which leaving the pole counts as a fall rather than a descent.

parameters.label: Maximum tracking gap
parameters.help: Longest tracking dropout that is bridged; movement across a longer gap is excluded. Increase only for low-frame-rate videos.

parameters.label: Cut-off time
parameters.help: Maximum trial duration; the trial is stopped at this time.

zones.label: Pole
zones.geometry: Polygon drawn on the side view around the pole where the subject climbs, from the base to the top.

zones.label: Base
zones.geometry: Polygon drawn on the side view over the floor area at the foot of the pole.

events.label: Turn completed
events.definition: A sample is on the pole when it lies in the pole zone and not in the base zone. The turn completes at the first tracked sample on the pole that is at least turn_descent_cm below the highest sample on the pole so far, before the base is reached or a fall.

events.label: Base reached
events.definition: The base is reached at the first tracked sample in the base zone after a sample on the pole, unless the subject fell first.

events.label: Fall
events.definition: A fall is a pair of consecutive tracked samples, at most max_sample_gap_s apart, from on the pole to the base or off the pole, with a downward speed above fall_speed_cm_s; it is placed at the later sample.

metrics.label: Time to turn (T-turn)
metrics.description: Time taken to turn head-downward; longer times suggest bradykinesia.
metrics.definition: Coordinates are in centimeters in the calibration's side view of the rig: x horizontal and y the height above the base (base at y = 0, top of the pole at y = pole_length_cm). Samples after max_trial_duration_s are ignored. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples separated by 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s. Time of the turn_complete event, measured from the trial start.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals, or (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when the event did not occur by max_trial_duration_s.

metrics.label: Total time (T-total)
metrics.description: Time from the start of the trial until the subject reaches the base.
metrics.definition: Time of the base_reached event, measured from the trial start. The cut-off time is not imputed.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals, or (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when the event did not occur by max_trial_duration_s.

metrics.label: Descent time
metrics.description: Time from completion of the turn to arrival at the base.
metrics.definition: Time from completion of the turn to arrival at the base.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing, for the same reason as the first missing event.

metrics.label: Descent speed
metrics.description: Pole length divided by descent time; lower speeds suggest impaired motor function.
metrics.definition: Pole length divided by descent time.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (ZERO_DENOMINATOR) when the descent time is 0; otherwise missing for the same reason as descent_time_s.

metrics.label: Fall detected
metrics.description: Whether the subject fell off the pole.
metrics.definition: 1 if a fall event occurred by max_trial_duration_s, otherwise 0.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there are no counted intervals.
